title: The Sea Moss Scam: Why 80% of Sea Moss Online Makes People Gag (And How to Spot Real Ocean-Crafted St. Lucia Moss)
subtitle: We tested the most popular sea moss gels on the market to uncover why some taste like fishy sludge while others deliver pure energy and 92 essential minerals.
hook: If you’ve ever ordered a jar of sea moss gel online, taken one spoonful, and immediately wanted to gag—you are far from alone.

Sea moss exploded on social media for its ability to deliver 92 of the 102 essential minerals human bodies need for daily energy, gut health, and immune support. But millions of buyers are leaving their jars untouched in the back of the fridge after just one try.

Why? Because most popular brands cut costs by sourcing pool-grown or mass-farmed Vietnamese sea moss. It’s cheap to manufacture, but because it grows in warm, stagnant waters, it absorbs fewer minerals, develops a slimy texture, and retains a harsh, fishy ocean aftertaste.
